summary: Visionary UX executive with 15+ years of experience leading digital transformation, product design, and UX strategy across enterprise-scale platforms. Proven success aligning user-centered design with product management goals, implementing scalable design systems, and driving data-informed prioritization in Agile and DevSecOps environments. Adept at leading high-performing teams, enabling AI-adjacent UX strategies, and optimizing enterprise workflows in complex, secure contexts.
strengths: AI-Ready UX: Intelligent Workflow Design & Automation
Remote Team Building, SOPs, Agile Integration
